prompt: Why is the platform on the paper ticket unreliable?
promptZh: 為什麼不能依照紙票上的月台資訊？

options.text: Engineers have repaired the signals ahead of schedule.
options.zh: 工程師已提早修好號誌。
options.whyZh: 公告只說預期修復，並未表示已完成。

options.text: The track closure has left the departure platform undecided.
options.zh: 軌道關閉，出發月台尚未確定。
options.whyZh: 號誌故障使軌道關閉；目前列車無法進站且新月台未定，不能依紙票前往。

options.text: Staff have confirmed that the train will leave from platform six.
options.zh: 站方已確認列車將從六號月台出發。
options.whyZh: 公告明確要求不要前往紙票上的六號月台。

options.text: Passengers must exchange paper tickets for new ones.
options.whyZh: 指示是看電子看板，並未要求換票。

explanationZh: 號誌故障使軌道關閉；目前列車無法進站且新月台未定，不能依紙票前往。
evidence: A signal fault has closed the eastern tracks | we cannot yet confirm a departure platform | Please do not proceed to platform six, which is shown on printed tickets.

vocabulary.note: 列車出發的月台；這班車尚未確認。
已事先預訂、銜接本班列車的後續交通。
